description: A short user maintained trail that leads to down to the shores of Atlin Lake. Infrastructure there is a 3 blade sign along Warm Bay Road.
directions: Located approximately 3.7 km south of Atlin along the Warm Bay Road (1.2 km south of the Pine Creek campground) where there is a parking area.

stats.Recreation District: Rec Dist - North Coast - Kalum - Cassiar

title: Atlin Beach Trail
